newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-ARM Financial vaults higher.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS-ARM Financial vaults higher.

text.p: Shares of asset management company ARM Financial Group Inc leaped more than 20 percent in early trading, making the company the most active issue on the American Stock Exchange.
The stock was up to 19 from its IPO price of $15 a share, priced late on Wednesday for trading Thursday by lead underwriter Morgan Stanley Co.

The stock priced above its original estimate of $12 to $14, although that range was raised to $14 to $16 this week due to strong demand. The number of shares was also raised to eight million from an earlier estimate of 5.75 million.
Analysts said the lure of buying into outsourcing pulled investors to Startek Inc SRT.N, which rose one point to 16 in heavy trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
"All these temporary staffing-type deals are always successful," said Vince Slavin, who tracks IPOs for Cantor Fitzgerald.

The Denver outsourcing company sold three million of the 3.67 million shares offered. The shares priced in the middle of their expected range of $14 to $16. Startek posted net losses in 1995 and 1994, according to its prospectus.
Several other IPOs were priced but not yet trading, including Aurora Biosciences Corp, which analysts said should rise at least a point.
"We're in a hot market; all the conditions are perfect because we had a very long lull -- four months of nothing. There's no fighting it," Slavin said.
Aurora will sell four million shares at $10 each, the middle of an estimated pricing range of $9 to $11.
Slavin said Aurora could also prosper because the underwriting group carefully placed the shares to try to weed out "flippers," who quickly sell stocks for short-term gains.
"Everyone is being a little more careful in the placement because no one wants to see their deals get crushed," he said.
Also priced but not yet trading are RWD Technologies Inc and Laser Power Corp.
Analysts have said RWD could surge. In its prospectus, RWD says it aims "to improve the productivity and effectiveness of workers in a complex operating environment."
